variables.name: DEBUGGER_LISTEN_SOCKET
variables.doc: Bind plain HTTP on this unix socket, whatever the configuration says about https. The socket is chmod 0600 and is the access control.

variables.name: DEBUGGER_UI_URL
variables.doc: The debugger origin, no trailing slash. uiUrl is it; apiUrl is it + /api; spEntityId is it + /saml/sp; acsUrl, sloUrl and wsfedAcsUrl are apiUrl + /samlacs, /samlslo and /wsfed.

variables.name: DEBUGGER_ALLOWED_ADDRESS_RANGES
variables.doc: A JSON array of address ranges. Non-empty is allow-list mode, which replaces the block-list; a list with no usable entry fails closed.

variables.name: NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS
variables.doc: The anchor for iya-sts's own certificate. Read by node itself.

paths.name: common
paths.doc: What the api requires as ../common/... and nothing more.

paths.name: generatedModel
paths.doc: The generated API document, configuration schema and this contract.

paths.name: version
paths.doc: The build's M.N.P.B, the same record as api/version.json.
